description: Output captured from the mail server's inbound sealing and from the Linux, Android and iOS/macOS VPN apps, each run unmodified on fixed inputs. Keys, seeds and message keys are fixed test inputs, and server_x25519_private is the X25519 key the mail server generated for that capture; salts, nonces and encapsulations are what the code drew. The VPN apps derive the login hash and vault key with the version 1 derivation of spec/account.md section 2.1 (password_derivation_v1) and write the vault wraps of section 3; each vault gives the vault key the app derived.
